content.title: Who won yesterday's IPL 2026 Royal Challengers Bangalore vs Mumbai Indians clash? A look at the IPL Points
content.text: Yesterday IPL Match RCB vs MI: The Royal Challengers Bangalore vs Mumbai Indians clash at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai produced one of the highest-scoring games of the season, with RCB posting 240/4 and MI replying with 222/5. Statistically, 240/4 stands as one of RCB’s strongest totals against MI, while MI’s 222/5 became their highest-ever score against Bengaluru in IPL history.ALSO READ: Nashik IT company horrorVirat Kohli scored 50 runs off 38 balls for RCB against MI on Sunday, April 12, 2026. Having reached his second fifty of the season, Virat Kohli was removed by Hardik Pandya. And one of the most talked-about moments came after his dismissal as the batter was visibly furious and vented his frustration by throwing his helmet and gloves.ALSO READ: Varuthini Ekadashi 2026 today or tomorrowYesterday IPL Match RCB vs MIRCB defeated MI by 18 runs in a high-scoring Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 clash yesterday. The Bengaluru team rode on explosive half-centuries from Phil Salt, Virat Kohli and Rajat Patidar to post 240/4 before restricting Mumbai to 222/5 despite a late blitz from Sherfane Rutherford.Chasing a daunting 241-run target, the MI explosively began their innings, with openers Rohit Sharma and Ryan Rickelton taking the attack to the RCB bowlers from the outset. But they suffered a major setback when Rohit Sharma walked off the field during the sixth over due to a hamstring issue, disrupting their rhythm at the top.Suryakumar Yadav scored 33 off 22, but his wicket to Krunal Pandya hurt MI’s chase. Skipper Hardik Pandya tried to revive the innings with a quick 40 off 22, but was dismissed at a key moment by Jacob Duffy. Rasikh Salam Dar removed Naman Dhir soon after, leaving MI struggling. A late explosive knock from Sherfane Rutherford (71 off 31, 9 sixes*) kept hopes alive, but MI ended at 222/5, falling short by 18 runs. Suyash Sharma was impressive with the ball, picking up two wickets for RCB.RCB vs MI resultRCB sealed a high-scoring win with dominant batting, while MI’s late fightback wasn’t enough to chase down the massive total.The match highlighted Royal Challengers Bengaluru’s strong batting depth, while exposing Mumbai Indians’s continued struggle to control key phases of the game, especially in high-scoring matches.IPL 2026 Match table after RCB vs MI matchDefending champions Royal Challengers Bengaluru stayed strong at third place in the IPL 2026 points table after beating Mumbai Indians by 18 runs at Wankhede Stadium. RCB now have 3 wins in 4 matches, with 6 points and a solid net run rate of +1.148.Mumbai Indians are struggling at eighth place, with just 1 win and 3 losses, and a net run rate of -0.772. At the top, Rajasthan Royals remain unbeaten with 4 wins in 4 matches, leading the table with 8 points and the best net run rate of +2.055.PositionTeamMatchesWinsLossesPointsNet Run Rate1Rajasthan Royals4408+2.0553Royal Challengers Bengaluru4316+1.1484Delhi Capitals4224+0.3225Gujarat Titans4224-0.0296Lucknow Super Giants4224-0.4277Sunrisers Hyderabad4132-0.0248Mumbai Indians4132-0.7729Chennai Super Kings4132-1.53210Kolkata Knight Riders4031-1.315Punjab Kings are second with 3 wins, 7 points, and a net run rate of +0.720. Delhi Capitals are in fourth place with 2 wins and 2 losses.Gujarat Titans and Lucknow Super Giants are fifth and sixth, both with 2 wins and 2 losses, but Gujarat have a slightly better net run rate.
